scope: This scanner retains original frozen HEAD, complete latest-50 non-merge order, original commit metadata, source blobs and every static rejection. REQUIRES_QUALIFICATION is not panel admission.
within_commit_tie_break: sorted source path, then the unique changed existing top-level function; license, original tests, no truncation, exact AFTER transport and actual isolated before/after qualification must all pass in commit order before selecting a task
after_static_scan: Qualify potential commits in the original saved order. Stop after the first qualifying task in this repository; process repositories in the appendix order and stop at four qualified tasks.
